drill.name: Goblet squat

howTo.setup: Stand on a clear level floor holding the coach-selected kettlebell at the chest. Practise the unloaded pattern first.
steps: Set feet in a comfortable stance and brace gently
Sit between the hips while keeping the whole foot grounded
Stand smoothly and finish tall without leaning back

dose.doseNote: Draft coaching range, not an athlete prescription. Coach approves the dose, load and total weekly work. Stop before technique changes.

coachComments: Keep the bell close and knees following the toes.
Correct: Heels lifting: reduce depth and practise without the bell.
Coach-cleared exercise only. Use the approved version; stop for pain, dizziness or loss of control.
Coach selects the load or assistance and decides whether independent practice is allowed.
adaptiveLevers: Easier: Unloaded squat to a comfortable depth.
Harder: Coach increases the load only after consistent depth and control.

trainingPolicy.loadingInstructions: Coach must choose and record the actual load/assistance for this exercise. Never infer weight from age, test percentile or an estimated 1RM.

filmingInstructions.primaryDemo: Show goblet squat from setup to finish at normal speed. Keep the whole body and equipment visible. Set feet in a comfortable stance and brace gently. Sit between the hips while keeping the whole foot grounded. Stand smoothly and finish tall without leaning back. Film both sides where relevant; show a reset rather than a fatigue set.
filmingInstructions.teachingDetail: Show the setup close enough to reproduce it: Stand on a clear level floor holding the coach-selected kettlebell at the chest. Practise the unloaded pattern first. Explain: Keep the bell close and knees following the toes. Demonstrate the easier option: Unloaded squat to a comfortable depth. Explain that the coach chooses progression and any external load.
filmingInstructions.errorCorrection: Explain the error without deliberately loading an unsafe position: Heels lifting: reduce depth and practise without the bell.
